purpose: Form SH-13 is used by a holder of securities of a company to nominate any person as their nominee in whom the securities shall vest in the event of their death.
who: Any holder of securities of a company
steps: Fill out and sign Form SH-13.
Submit the nomination form to the company.
The company records the request for nomination within two months from the date of receipt.
A corresponding entry is made forthwith in the relevant register of securities holders.
checklist: Ensure Form SH-13 is duly filled and signed.
If securities are held jointly by more than one person, ensure all joint holders together sign the nomination form.
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
